title: Host metrics sidecar: lightweight hardware monitoring for the agent container
objective: Add a minimal metrics sidecar that exposes GPU, CPU, RAM, and temperature data via HTTP so the agent can read host-level statistics from inside its sandbox. Implementation includes: (1) agent/metrics/gather.py — Python HTTP service polling /proc and parsing nvidia-smi with 2s TTL cache; (2) agent/metrics/Dockerfile + compose.yaml metrics service (internal network only, no host ports, read-only rootfs, all capabilities dropped); (3) agent/opencode/plugins/host-metrics/ — v2 plugin registering the get_host_metrics() tool for on-demand queries; (4) agent/opencode/plugins/host-metrics-tui/ — bonus sparkline plugin that renders live GPU/VRAM/RAM gauges in the TUI sidebar footer. Security: no host port published, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only filesystem, only /proc and /sys/class/{hwmon,thermal} mounted :ro.

Verified via README.md documentation, DECISIONS.md references, and agent/README.md integration docs. Legacy MD deleted as part of ticket cleanup.
